2026-10-15.content:
**Face detection model update**

The emotion label response in the Cloud Vision API is deprecated. Going forward,
the Cloud Vision API face detection (`FACE_DETECTION` feature) will return
`UNKNOWN` for all emotion-related labels.

summary.title: Emotion labels deprecated
summary.summary: The emotion labels in the face detection feature of the Cloud Vision API are now deprecated. Future responses will return 'UNKNOWN' for all emotion-related labels.
